batch.prompt: Use the reference only for drawing style. Create one isolated illustration: Two small open hands next to each other, palms facing the viewer, five natural fingers on each hand, wrists cropped consistently. Isolated without soap, water or tools. Warm contemporary children's book illustration, fine brown pencil lines, soft watercolor shading, natural proportions and muted sage, ochre and terracotta. Isolated on pure white without text, scenery or cast shadows. Show only the requested concept, with its essential identifying details large and readable. No decorative scene, no lettering or card border.
